Notes_and_Tips: Use eggs as a primary protein source but keep portion moderate (2 eggs max per meal).
When eating 2 meals, prefer later meals (skip or keep breakfast light).
Limit late-night eating and refined sugars to support weight loss.
Aim for improved sleep duration to help metabolic health.
Include daily brisk walking for 20–30 minutes.
